database_summary: Soccer (football) dataset containing player master data, time-versioned player attributes, match events/boxscore-style per-match records, team master data, time-versioned team attributes, and league/country lookup tables. Matches contain lineup player references and many textual event/aggregate columns. Player_Attributes and Team_Attributes are historical snapshots (measurements) tied to dates. Player, Team, League, Country are descriptive/master entities.

accepted.name: player_latest_attributes
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  pa.id AS id,
  pa.player_fifa_api_id AS player_fifa_api_id,
  pa.player_api_id AS player_api_id,
  pa.date AS date,
  pa.overall_rating AS overall_rating,
  pa.potential AS potential,
  pa.preferred_foot AS preferred_foot,
  pa.attacking_work_rate AS attacking_work_rate,
  pa.defensive_work_rate AS defensive_work_rate,
  pa.crossing AS crossing,
  pa.finishing AS finishing,
  pa.heading_accuracy AS heading_accuracy,
  pa.short_passing AS short_passing,
  pa.volleys AS volleys,
  pa.dribbling AS dribbling,
  pa.curve AS curve,
  pa.free_kick_accuracy AS free_kick_accuracy,
  pa.long_passing AS long_passing,
  pa.ball_control AS ball_control,
  pa.acceleration AS acceleration,
  pa.sprint_speed AS sprint_speed,
  pa.agility AS agility,
  pa.reactions AS reactions,
  pa.balance AS balance,
  pa.shot_power AS shot_power,
  pa.jumping AS jumping,
  pa.stamina AS stamina,
  pa.strength AS strength,
  pa.long_shots AS long_shots,
  pa.aggression AS aggression,
  pa.interceptions AS interceptions,
  pa.positioning AS positioning,
  pa.vision AS vision,
  pa.penalties AS penalties,
  pa.marking AS marking,
  pa.standing_tackle AS standing_tackle,
  pa.sliding_tackle AS sliding_tackle,
  pa.gk_diving AS gk_diving,
  pa.gk_handling AS gk_handling,
  pa.gk_kicking AS gk_kicking,
  pa.gk_positioning AS gk_positioning,
  pa.gk_reflexes AS gk_reflexes,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.player_api_id ORDER BY datetime(pa.date) DESC) AS latest_attr_rank
FROM player_attributes pa
accepted.description: Latest Player_Attributes snapshot per player_api_id (one row per player_api_id) with attribute measures. Use when you need each player's most recent observable attributes for joins, comparisons, or ranking. | Use for: Compare current overall_rating or potential across players; Join most-recent player attributes to player master for demographics; Find players above/below thresholds using latest attributes; Top-K players by overall_rating using latest snapshot (filter where latest_attr_rank=1 then rank)

accepted.name: match_basic_summary
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  match_api_id,
  country_id,
  league_id,
  season,
  stage,
  date,
  home_team_api_id,
  away_team_api_id,
  home_team_goal,
  away_team_goal,
  (home_team_goal - away_team_goal) AS goal_diff,
  possession,
  B365H,
  B365D,
  B365A,
  BWH,
  BWD,
  BWA,
  IWH,
  IWD,
  IWA,
  LBH,
  LBD,
  LBA,
  PSH,
  PSD,
  PSA,
  WHH,
  WHD,
  WHA,
  SJH,
  SJD,
  SJA,
  VCH,
  VCD,
  VCA,
  GBH,
  GBD,
  GBA,
  BSH,
  BSD,
  BSA
FROM Match
accepted.description: One row per Match summarizing basic measures and results: goals, possession (as text), and common bookmaker odds. Use for match-level analytics, joining to league/team or aggregating across seasons. | Use for: Aggregate average odds by league/season; Analyze goal differentials by team/season; Filter matches with missing odds or compute derived win probabilities

accepted.name: player_master_demographics
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  player_api_id,
  player_name,
  player_fifa_api_id,
  birthday,
  CASE WHEN birthday IS NOT NULL AND trim(birthday) != '' THEN CAST((julianday(date('now')) - julianday(birthday))/365.25 AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS age_years,
  height,
  weight
FROM Player
accepted.description: Cleaned player master table projecting identifier and demographic fields useful for joins: player_api_id, player_name, player_fifa_api_id, birthday, age_years (derived), height, weight. Age is computed relative to current_date() via julianday for reuse; may be NULL when birthday is NULL. | Use for: Filter players by age range or height/weight; Join player demographics to attributes or match participation; Compute age distributions per league/season after joining matches

accepted.name: league_with_country
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  League.id AS id,
  League.country_id AS country_id,
  League.name AS name,
  Country.id AS country_id__country,
  Country.name AS name__country
FROM League
LEFT JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
accepted.description: Denormalized League rows joined to Country to expose league name and country name. Use when reporting or aggregating by country or when joining matches to country-level labels. | Use for: Show leagues and their countries for match-level aggregations; Group matches by Country.name via league join
